phases.observation: Fixed package identity, AMD64 payload and local protection baseline matched the dispatch contract.

After the preserved UAC-elevation failure, the user explicitly authorized a manual continuation and ran the fixed command once in an administrator PowerShell under the same Windows user. Output reported succeeded=true and the expected persistent independent 18u installation. Post-install payload, ownership, COM, TIP, profile, category and protection checks passed.
User confirmed work saved. A normal restart without forced close completed; the new boot time was later than maintenance completion. Installed and protected product identities remained valid.
The user ran the fixed installed-host command once in a foreground ordinary PowerShell. Raw evidence was complete and matched every fixed success field; host and broker stderr were empty.

notes: The original local result.json and UAC failure log remain unchanged; this file records the explicitly authorized manual continuation.
No automatic retry was performed and ResetData was never requested.

Standard YimeCore updated diagnostic/startup state after reboot. Stable user content and historical evidence remained present and no user-content reset was detected; locked live files were not byte-read, so full byte-for-byte user-data preservation is not claimed.
No performance, finger, pen, mouse, Word, Edge, flipped-panel or other testing was run or inherited. This is not overall product or physical acceptance.
